name: Forest Depths
description: Scout deep into the Whispering Canopy to map the layout.

narrative.accept: Silas notes, "The woods have grown denser. I need someone to scout deep into the Whispering Canopy and map out the pathways."
narrative.complete: "Excellent work. This map will keep travelers safe. Keep your guard up, though."
narrative.hint: Scout the Shadow Forest 3 times using the explore command.
